blocks.text: Cells ke andar aur bahar maddon (substances) ki harkat (movement) cell ke kaamon ke liye nihayat zaroori hai: ghizai ajza (nutrients) lena, fuzla (waste) nikalna, gases ka tabadla (exchange) aur signal transduction. Cells is harkat ko qaboo karne ke liye plasma membrane par inhisar karte hain. Membrane transport ke tareeqe (mechanisms) woh amal hain jo cell ko homeostasis qaim rakhne, ghizai ajza hasil karne, fuzla nikalne aur apne mahol (environment) se rabta rakhne dete hain. Is ki do qismein hain: passive transport, jise tawanai (energy) nahin chahiye, aur active transport, jo tawanai istemal karta hai.

blocks.title: Tawazun (equilibrium)
blocks.text: Cell ke mahol se madde ka tabadla karte hue plasma membranes cell ke andar aur bahar dono taraf tawazun qaim rakhti hain.
Passive transport
Plasma membrane ke paar molecules ki harkat jis mein koi tawanai kharch na ho passive transport hai. Is ki qismein diffusion, facilitated diffusion aur osmosis hain.
Diffusion

Diffusion kisi madde (liquid ya gas) ki zyada concentration wali jagah se kam concentration wali jagah ki taraf khalis (net) harkat hai, yani concentration gradient ke saath. Kyunke jab molecules membrane ke paar diffuse hote hain to cell tawanai kharch nahin karta, diffusion passive transport ki ek qisam hai.

blocks.alt: Waqt ki tarteeb mein teen khane, teeron se jure. Har ek mein surakhon wali membrane jagah ko baant'ti hai; shuru mein neele molecules zyada tar baen aur hare daen hain; dono qismein surakhon se guzarti hain yahan tak ke aakhri khane mein har qism dono taraf barabar phail jati hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.34: Do qisam ke molecules ki diffusion (textbook ki Figure 3.34 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har qism ke molecules apni zyada concentration se kam concentration ki taraf jate hain, doosri qism se be-niyaz. Aakhir mein dono taraf barabari (equilibrium) ho jati hai; is mein koi energy kharch nahin hoti.
Facilitated diffusion

Kuch molecules plasma membrane mein maujood transport proteins ki madad se cells ke andar ya bahar liye jate hain. Jab transport protein kisi madde ko us ke concentration gradient ke saath (zyada se kam concentration ki taraf) harkat mein madad deta hai, to is amal ko facilitated diffusion kehte hain. Yeh bhi passive hai, kyunke tawanai istemal nahin hoti. Is ki raftar is par munhasir hai ke membrane mein kitne transport-protein molecules maujood hain. Is mein shamil transport proteins ki bunyadi qismein yeh hain:

blocks.alt: Plasma membrane (phospholipid bilayer) jis ke aar-paar transport protein hai. Ek taraf ke solute molecules transport protein se guzar kar doosri taraf, apni concentration gradient ke rukh, chale jate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.35: Facilitated diffusion (textbook ki Figure 3.35 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

items: Channel proteins: yeh membrane ke paar hydrophilic channels banate hain jo khaas molecules ya ions ko guzarne dete hain. Yeh gated ya non-gated ho sakte hain; gated channels khaas muharrikat (jaise voltage ki tabdeeli, ligand ka jurna ya mechanical dabao) ke jawab mein khulte ya band hote hain. Misalein: ion channels (khaas ions jaise Na+, K+, Ca2+ aur Cl- ke liye) aur aquaporins (pani ke molecules ke tez transport ke liye).

Carrier proteins (transporters): yeh us khaas molecule se jurte hain jise transport karte hain, apni shakal badalte hain, aur molecule ko membrane ke paar le jate hain. Yeh bohat makhsoos hain aur saturate ho sakte hain: jab tamam carrier proteins masroof hon to transport ki ek zyada se zyada raftar hoti hai. Misalein: glucose transporters aur amino acid transporters.

blocks.text: Osmosis

Woh amal jis mein pani ke molecules cell membrane ke paar zyada concentration wali jagah se kam concentration wali jagah diffuse hote hain osmosis hai. Kyunke pani zyada se kam concentration ki taraf jata hai, osmosis ko cell ki tawanai nahin chahiye; yeh pani ka passive transport hai. Osmosis ki simt (direction) membrane ke dono taraf solutes ki concentration par munhasir hai: pani hamesha hypotonic solution (kam solute concentration) se hypertonic solution (zyada solute concentration) ki taraf jata hai.

blocks.title: Tonicity
blocks.text: Tonicity solutions mein solutes ki nisbati (relative) concentration hai. Hypertonic solutions mein zyada solute hota hai; hypotonic solutions mein kam solute; isotonic solutions mein solutes ki barabar concentration.

Osmosis ek chun kar guzarne-dene wali (selectively permeable) membrane se hota hai, jo pani ko guzarne deti hai magar bohat se solutes ko rokti hai. Yeh cell ki turgor qaim rakhne ke liye, jo poday ke cells ke liye nihayat zaroori hai, aur cells ke andar pani ki miqdar mutawazan rakhne ke liye aham hai. Osmosis ki simt aur raftar osmotic gradient aur membrane ki pani ke liye permeability se mutasir hoti hai. Aquaporins naami makhsoos proteins membrane ke paar pani ke molecules ke tez transport mein madad dete hain, jis se cell ki pani ki miqdar aur hajm (volume) ka moassar intezam hota hai.

blocks.alt: Selectively permeable membrane hypotonic solution (baen) ko hypertonic solution (daen) se alag karti hai. Har solute molecule ke gird pani ke molecules ka guchha hai; azaad pani ke molecules hypotonic taraf zyada hain. Neeche teer pani ka net bahao (net flow) hypotonic se hypertonic taraf dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.36: Molecular satah par osmosis (textbook ki Figure 3.36 ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Solute ke gird chipka pani aazadi se nahin ghoom sakta. Hypotonic taraf azaad pani zyada hai, is liye pani ke zyada molecules wahan se membrane paar karte hain: net bahao hypertonic taraf hota hai.

blocks.title: Reverse osmosis
blocks.text: Reverse osmosis pani ko aaloodgi (contaminants) aur na-paki se saaf karne ki aam istemal hone wali technology hai. Qudrati osmosis, jo pani ko kam se zyada solute concentration ki taraf le jata hai, ke bar-aks reverse osmosis bahar se dabao (pressure) laga kar pani ko semi-permeable membrane se zyada se kam solute concentration ki taraf dhakelta hai. Yeh hal-shuda namak aur doosri na-paki ko chhaan deta hai aur saaf, mehfooz peene ka pani deta hai. Yeh water treatment plants, desalination ke idaron aur gharelu water purification systems mein istemal hota hai.

blocks.alt: Do U-tubes, har ek ke neeche semipermeable membrane jo concentrated solution aur contaminants (baen bazu) ko khalis pani (solvent, daen bazu) se alag karti hai. Osmosis: pani khalis pani se concentrated solution mein jata hai aur us ki satah oonchi ho jati hai; satah ka farq osmotic pressure hai. Reverse osmosis: solution par lagaya gaya dabao (applied pressure) pani ko membrane se khalis pani ki taraf dhakelta hai aur contaminants peeche reh jate hain.
blocks.caption: Osmosis aur reverse osmosis (textbook ke Reverse osmosis box ki drawing ke mutabiq asal drawing).

blocks.text: Active transport
Plasma membrane ke paar maddon ki kam concentration se zyada concentration ki taraf harkat, tawanai kharch kar ke, active transport hai. Plasma membrane se is ki yeh qismein hoti hain.
Carrier proteins se active transport

Is amal mein plasma membrane ke carrier (transport) proteins tawanai istemal kar ke molecules ko concentration gradient ke khilaf le jate hain. Maslan nerve cells ki membranes mein carrier proteins sodium-potassium pump ki shakal mein hote hain. Aaram ki halat (resting) wale nerve cell mein (jo impulse nahin chala raha) yeh pump tawanai (ATP) kharch kar ke cell ke andar K+ ki zyada aur Na+ ki kam concentration qaim rakhta hai. Is ke liye pump Na+ ko cell ke bahar aur K+ ko andar faal taur par le jata hai.

blocks.alt: Cell ke bahar (oopar) aur cytoplasm (neeche) ke darmiyan plasma membrane, jis mein transport proteins chaar lagatar halaton mein. Na+ ions cytoplasm ki taraf se pump se jurte hain; ATP ek phosphate (P) deta hai aur ADP bachta hai; pump bahar ki taraf khul kar Na+ bahar chhorta hai; bahar se K+ ions jurte hain; pump phosphate chhor kar wapas palatta hai aur K+ ko cytoplasm mein chhor deta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.37: Carrier proteins ke zariye active transport (textbook ki Figure 3.37 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Outside cell, Transport protein, Plasma membrane, Na+, K+, P, ATP, ADP, Cytoplasm.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yahan ions kam concentration se zyada concentration ki taraf jate hain, is liye energy (ATP) chahiye. Na+ bahar aur K+ andar dhakele jate hain, aur ATP ka phosphate pump ki shakal badal deta hai.
Endocytosis

Endocytosis mein bhari (bulky) madde plasma membrane ke paar cell ke andar laye jate hain. Plasma membrane ka ek hissa andar ko dhansta hai (invaginate); bahar ka madda is dhanse hisse mein liya jata hai aur us ke sire band ho jate hain, jis se ek chhoti vesicle banti hai jo plasma membrane se alag ho kar cytoplasm mein chali jati hai. Is ki do aam shaklein phagocytosis, jis mein cell thos madda leta hai, aur pinocytosis, jis mein cell qatron (droplets) ki shakal mein maaye (liquids) leta hai, hain.

blocks.title: Receptor-mediated endocytosis
blocks.text: Plasma membrane ke khaas receptor proteins bahar se madda uthate hain aur andar ko dab kar vesicle banate hain. Maslan jigar ke cells mein cholesterol ke receptor proteins hote hain. Cholesterol khoon mein low-density lipoproteins (LDLs) ki shakal mein ghoomta hai; jigar ke cell ki membrane ke receptor proteins LDLs ko pehchan kar receptor-mediated endocytosis se khoon se le lete hain.

blocks.alt: LDL particle (proteins wali phospholipid bahari tah, andar cholesterol) plasma membrane ki taraf aata hai, membrane ke garhe mein receptor proteins se jurta hai, aur vesicle mein band ho kar cytoplasm mein chala jata hai.
blocks.caption: LDL ki receptor-mediated endocytosis (textbook ke Receptor-mediated endocytosis box ki drawing ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: LDL particle, Phospholipid outer layer, Cholesterol, Protein, Plasma membrane, Receptor protein, Vesicle, Cytoplasm.

blocks.text: Exocytosis

Exocytosis woh amal hai jis se bhari madda cell se bahar bheja jata hai. Madda membrane ke andar pack ho kar vesicle banata hai; vesicle plasma membrane tak jati hai aur us se mil kar apna mawad cell ke bahar ke mahol mein chhor deti hai.

blocks.alt: (A) Endocytosis: cell ke bahar ka zarra plasma membrane ki andar ki taraf jeb (pocket) mein ghir jata hai jo toot kar cell ke andar vesicle ban jati hai; maada andar aa jata hai. (B) Exocytosis: andar band maade wale vesicles plasma membrane tak jate hain, us se mil kar khulte hain aur maada cell se bahar nikal jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.38: (A) Endocytosis, (B) Exocytosis (textbook ki Figure 3.38 ke mutabiq asal drawing).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Plasma membrane, Outside of cell, Inside of cell, Material imported, Material exported, Material packed in vesicle.

blocks.caption: Simple diffusion, facilitated diffusion aur active transport
rows: Hamesha zyada se kam concentration ki taraf?

blocks.prompt: Endocytosis aur exocytosis ko active transport mein kyun gina jata hai halanke yeh akele molecules ko gradient ke khilaf pump nahin karte?
blocks.explanation: Dono mein cell ko tawanai kharch karni parti hai: vesicle banana, alag karna aur le jana, aur use membrane se milana, sab ATP istemal karte hain. Tawanai ka kharch, sirf simt nahin, kisi amal ko active banata hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Passive transport ko tawanai nahin chahiye aur yeh concentration gradient ke saath jata hai: simple diffusion (chhote non-polar molecules bilayer se), facilitated diffusion (polar ya charged molecules channel ya carrier proteins se; raftar proteins ki tadaad se mehdood) aur osmosis (pani chun kar guzarne-dene wali membrane se, hypotonic se hypertonic, aksar aquaporins se).
Tonicity: hypertonic mein zyada solute, hypotonic mein kam, isotonic mein barabar. Reverse osmosis dabao se pani ko ulti simt dhakel kar saaf karta hai.

Active transport ATP kharch karta hai: sodium-potassium pump jaise carrier pumps ions ko gradient ke khilaf le jate hain; endocytosis (phagocytosis, pinocytosis, receptor-mediated) bhari madda vesicles se andar lata hai; exocytosis use bahar bhejta hai.
